g.text: Declared focus positions and real artwork. Schematic spacing; not a native screenshot. Hover a node for its full purpose.

g.title: FAT_nat_accounts_at_the_gate | Accounts at the Gate | Opening allocation hearing chooses a public or executive accounting procedure.
FAT_nat_civilian_priority | Protect the Civilian Order Book | Enduring civilian priority: construction and stability, with a military-output cost.
FAT_nat_plant_priority | The Plant Comes First | Alternative industrial priority: military output with consumer and stability burdens.
FAT_nat_invoice_rules | An Invoice Must Name Its Author | Unlock a paid invoice audit that improves institutional capacity and records an inspected warrant.
FAT_nat_labour_bench | A Place for the Workshop Delegate | Unlock a negotiated maintenance interval, exchanging current output for reliability.
FAT_nat_reserve_floor | The Reserve Is Not a Promise | Require a larger domestic infantry reserve before delivery; unlock a smaller emergency consignment.
FAT_nat_border_book | The Border Accounts | Choose local verification or central review of existing border accounts.
FAT_nat_route_contract | Contract for the Journey | Unlock stock-backed motor-transport warrants.
FAT_nat_partner_register | A Register of Willing Recipients | Unlock bounded requests to three eligible existing partners, with receiver consent.
FAT_nat_consent_clause | Consent Survives the Signature | Allow a longer consent window and recipient revocation; no automatic delivery.
FAT_nat_shopfloor_ballot | The Shift Meeting | Unlock a paid, temporary negotiated extra shift with an explicit rest cooldown.
FAT_nat_rolling_gauges | The Rolling Gauges | Unlock a temporary loading-efficiency allocation that reserves a civilian factory.
FAT_nat_spare_batch | A Batch That Can Be Spared | Unlock fixed infantry-equipment warrants backed by actual stock.
FAT_nat_testing_bench | Before the Crate Is Sealed | Unlock a separate support-equipment warrant with its own stock test.
FAT_nat_delivery_ledger | Two Open Commitments | Raise the maximum simultaneous pending or accepted warrants from one to two.
FAT_nat_no_blank_cheques | No Blank Cheques | Allow costless administrative withdrawal of an unfulfilled warrant.
FAT_nat_domestic_dispatch | Dispatch to Our Own Depots | Unlock a domestic training allocation that consumes infantry stock instead of donating it.
FAT_nat_signed_ceiling | The Signed Ceiling | Choose a restraint rule or a time-limited emergency authorisation.
FAT_nat_wartime_return | The Return from the Works | Assess an actual war, peaceful or subject context and choose a production burden.
FAT_nat_essential_quota | An Essential Civilian Quota | Replace the initial priority with protected repair capacity and lower military output.
FAT_nat_surge_quota | The Limited Surge Schedule | Alternative industrial surge policy with consumer and political burdens.
FAT_nat_neutrality_file | Keep a Neutrality File | Unlock domestic conversion of a refused or withdrawn offer, with real domestic stock expenditure.
FAT_nat_refugee_freight | A Freight Slot for Relief | Unlock a relief freight allocation consuming motor stock and civilian capacity.
FAT_nat_host_capacity | Room Behind the Platform | Unlock a temporary civil reception allocation with consumer-goods cost.
FAT_nat_requisition_window | The First Refused Requisition | A refusal scene chooses domestic finality or a costed fresh request procedure.
FAT_nat_arbitration_desk | A Smaller Request | Unlock the smaller stock-backed infantry warrant as an alternative quantity.
FAT_nat_three_signatures | The Third Signature | Raise the open-warrant ceiling to three; the ceiling never grows further.
FAT_nat_exhausted_shifts | Listen to the Exhausted Shift | Unlock a rest-and-inspection alternative that cannot overlap an extra shift.
FAT_nat_family_accounts | The Invoices at Home | Settlement or peaceful domestic assessment chooses repair priorities without altering war outcomes.
FAT_nat_relief_quota | Relief without a New Treaty | Unlock an enhanced local reception allocation only after the owning postwar response, or a peaceful substitute.
FAT_nat_inventory_recovery | Recover the Maintenance Margin | Unlock support-stock expenditure for a bounded maintenance benefit.
FAT_nat_civilian_consignment | The Civilian Consignment | Allow domestic support allocation as an alternative to infantry training.
FAT_nat_audited_settlement | An Audited Settlement Account | Choose a closed local settlement file or continuing independent scrutiny.
FAT_nat_occupation_liaison | A Desk under Supervision | Unlock a subject-compatible civil liaison; independent countries use the same desk for domestic coordination.
FAT_nat_unbroken_production | Keep the Existing Lines Running | Unlock a production-retention allocation with staff and fiscal opportunity costs.
FAT_nat_local_obligation_register | The Obligations that Remain | Unlock a once-only reconciliation of current warrants and a domestic institutional review.
FAT_nat_renewal_hearing | Renew the Mandate in Public | 2006 renewal scene selects scrutiny or a bounded executive mandate.
FAT_nat_open_tenders | Publish the Tender | Standing open-procurement policy with industrial and political tradeoffs.
FAT_nat_directed_orders | A Directed Order Book | Alternative directed-procurement policy with a consumer and legitimacy cost.
FAT_nat_contract_appeal | An Appeal before Dispatch | Allow withdrawal after acceptance without a penalty; completed deliveries remain final.
FAT_nat_supplier_liability | The Supplier Must Answer | Procurement failure scene chooses a paid independent inspection or a disclosed limited repair.
FAT_nat_skilled_shift | Retain the Skilled Shift | Unlock a skill-retention allocation; it competes with the existing production interval.
FAT_nat_domestic_veto | The Domestic Veto | Unlock immediate cancellation of all unfulfilled warrants and return to domestic work.
FAT_nat_joint_inspection | Invite a Receiving Inspector | Unlock recipient choice of inspected cooperation rather than automatic extra stock.
FAT_nat_independent_audit | The Auditor Keeps a Separate Key | Unlock a standing audit policy with a distinct institutional cost.
FAT_nat_civilian_retainer | Retain Civilian Repair Capacity | Terminal civilian retainer replaces earlier production priorities.
FAT_nat_industrial_retainer | Retain the Industrial Reserve | Alternative terminal industrial retainer replaces earlier production priorities.
FAT_nat_alternate_deliveries | An Alternative after Interruption | Allow a fresh domestic transport allocation after a cancelled external warrant.
FAT_nat_outstanding_accounts | The Outstanding Accounts | 2013 assessment selects accountable cooperation or a domestic-first conclusion.
FAT_nat_winding_warrants | Close the Expired Warrants | Unlock a registry sweep of expired or ineligible partner warrants.
FAT_nat_standing_transport | A Standing Dispatch Standard | Extend the paid domestic transport option to peaceful routine use.
FAT_nat_no_automatic_successor | No Automatic Successor | Unlock a succession review that closes outstanding warrants before a new domestic mandate.
FAT_nat_public_commitment_limit | A Public Commitment Limit | Unlock a funded compliance interval that improves capacity while limiting current output.
FAT_nat_bounded_cooperation | Cooperation within the Means | Unlock a final assessment action with distinct subject, domestic and delivered-cooperation outcomes.
